items.source: Pause all beans in this application context if necessary, and subsequently restart all auto-startup beans, effectively restoring the lifecycle state after refresh() (typically after a preceding pause() call when a full Lifecycle.start() of even lazy-starting beans is to be avoided).
items.translation: 如有必要，暂停此应用上下文中的所有 Bean，随后重新启动所有自动启动的 Bean，从而在调用refresh()（通常在先前的pause() 调用之后，以避免对即使是懒启动的 Bean 也进行完整的Lifecycle.start()）后恢复生命周期状态。

items.source: Stop all beans in this application context unless they explicitly opt out of pausing through SmartLifecycle.isPauseable() returning false.
items.translation: 除非它们通过 `SmartLifecycle.isPauseable()` 返回 `false` 明确选择暂停，否则停止此应用上下文中的所有 Bean。

items.source: Name of the ApplicationStartup bean in the factory: "applicationStartup".
items.translation: 工厂中 `ApplicationStartup` 豆的名称：`applicationStartup`。

items.source: Name of the Environment bean in the factory: "environment".
items.translation: 工厂中名为 "environment" 的 `Environment` bean 的名称。

items.source: Name of the shutdown hook thread: "SpringContextShutdownHook".
items.translation: Name 的 shutdown hook 线程："SpringContextShutdownHook"。

items.source: Return the ApplicationStartup for this application context.
items.translation: 返回此应用上下文的ApplicationStartup。

items.source: Remove the given ApplicationListener from this context's set of listeners, assuming it got registered via addApplicationListener(ApplicationListener) before.
items.translation: 从此上下文的监听器集合中移除给定的 `ApplicationListener`，前提是它之前已通过addApplicationListener(ApplicationListener)进行了注册。

items.source: Generally, this internal factory will only be accessible while the context is active, that is, in-between refresh() and close(). The isActive() flag can be used to check whether the context is in an appropriate state.
items.translation: 通常，此内部工厂仅在上下文处于活动状态时可用，即在refresh()和close()之间。可以使用isActive()标志来检查上下文是否处于适当的状态。

items.source: If such a bean is supplied, the context will use a temporary ClassLoader for type matching, in order to allow the LoadTimeWeaver to process all actual bean classes.
items.translation: 如果提供了这样的 Bean，上下文将使用临时的ClassLoader进行类型匹配，以便让LoadTimeWeaver处理所有实际的 Bean 类。

items.source: The name of the shutdown hook thread should be SHUTDOWN_HOOK_THREAD_NAME.
items.translation: 关闭钩子线程的name应为SHUTDOWN_HOOK_THREAD_NAME。

items.source: Note: This does not indicate whether context shutdown has completed. Use isActive() for differentiating between those scenarios: a context becomes inactive once it has been fully shut down and the original close() call has returned.
items.translation: 注意：这并不表示上下文关闭是否已完成。请使用isActive()来区分这些场景：一旦上下文完全关闭且原始的close()调用返回后，该上下文即变为非活动状态。

items.source: Note: Does not invoke close on a parent context; parent contexts have their own, independent lifecycle.
items.translation: 注意：不 在父上下文中调用 close；父上下文拥有自己独立的生命周期。

items.source: This method can be called multiple times without side effects: Subsequent close calls on an already closed context will be ignored.
items.translation: 此方法可以多次调用且无副作用：对已关闭上下文的后续 close 调用将被忽略。

items.source:
Configuration and lifecycle methods are encapsulated here to avoid
making them obvious to ApplicationContext client code. The present
methods should only be used by startup and shutdown code.
items.translation: 配置和生命周期方法在此处被封装，以避免使 ApplicationContext 客户端代码能够轻易访问它们。当前方法仅应由启动和关闭代码使用。

items.source: If none is supplied, no background bootstrapping will be active.
items.translation: 如果未提供，则不会激活后台引导。

items.source: If none is supplied, default conversion rules apply.
items.translation: 如果未提供，则应用默认转换规则。

items.source:
Note that the parent shouldn't be changed: It should only be set outside
a constructor if it isn't available when an object of this class is created,
for example in case of WebApplicationContext setup.
items.translation: 注意不应更改父对象：如果创建此类的对象时不可用，则只能在构造函数之外设置它，例如在 WebApplicationContext 配置的情况下。

items.source:
This allows the application context to record metrics
during startup.
items.translation: 这允许应用程序上下文在启动期间记录指标。

items.source:
Note that any ApplicationListener registered here will be applied
on refresh if the context is not active yet, or on the fly with the
current event multicaster in case of a context that is already active.
items.translation: 注意，在此注册的任意 `ApplicationListener` 将在上下文尚未激活时于刷新时应用，或在上下文已激活的情况下通过当前的事件多播器即时应用。

items.source: This context class loader will be passed to the internal bean factory.
items.translation: 此上下文类加载器将传递给内部 Bean 工厂。

items.source:
Any such resolver will be invoked ahead of this context's standard
resolution rules. It may therefore also override any default rules.
items.translation: 任何此类解析器都将在该上下文的常规解析规则之前被调用。因此，它也可能覆盖任何默认规则。

items.source:
As this is a startup method, it should destroy already created singletons
if it fails, to avoid dangling resources. In other words, after invocation
of this method, either all or no singletons at all should be instantiated.
items.translation: 由于这是一个启动方法，如果失败，它应该销毁已创建的单例，以避免资源悬空。换句话说，在调用此方法后，要么所有单例都已实例化，要么一个单例都没有实例化。

items.source:
This method can be called multiple times. Only one shutdown hook
(at max) will be registered for each context instance.
items.translation: 此方法可以多次调用。每个上下文实例最多注册一个关闭钩子。

items.source:
Note: Do not use this to post-process the bean factory; singletons
will already have been instantiated before. Use a BeanFactoryPostProcessor
to intercept the BeanFactory setup process before beans get touched.
items.translation: 注意：不要使用此方法对 Bean 工厂进行后处理；单例在之前已经实例化。请使用 BeanFactoryPostProcessor 在触及 Bean 之前拦截 BeanFactory 的设置过程。

items.source: Return whether this context has been closed already, that is, whether close() has been called on an active context in order to initiate its shutdown.
items.translation: 返回此上下文是否已关闭，即是否在活动上下文中调用了close()以启动其关闭。

items.source: Set the ApplicationStartup for this application context.
items.translation: 为此应用程序上下文设置ApplicationStartup。

items.source: Any number of these characters are considered delimiters between multiple context config paths in a single String value: ",; \t\n".
items.translation: 任意数量的这些字符均被视为单个 `<code>String` 值中多个上下文配置路径之间的分隔符：",; \t\n"。

items.source: Return the Environment for this application context in configurable form, allowing for further customization.
items.translation: 以可配置的形式返回此应用上下文的Environment，允许进行进一步自定义。

items.source: Set the Environment for this application context.
items.translation: 为此应用程序上下文设置Environment。

items.source: Name of the Operating System environment bean in the factory: "systemEnvironment".
items.translation: 工厂中操作系统环境 Bean 的名称为："systemEnvironment"。

items.source: Name of the JVM System properties bean in the factory: "systemProperties".
items.translation: 工厂中 JVM 系统属性 Bean 的名称："systemProperties"。

items.source:
Determine whether this application context is active, that is,
whether it has been refreshed at least once and has not been closed yet.
items.translation: 确定此应用程序上下文是否处于活动状态，即它是否至少刷新过一次且尚未关闭。

items.source: Set the unique ID of this application context.
items.translation: 设置此应用程序上下文的唯一 ID。

items.source:
Add a new BeanFactoryPostProcessor that will get applied to the internal
bean factory of this application context on refresh, before any of the
bean definitions get evaluated. To be invoked during context configuration.
items.translation: 添加一个新的 BeanFactoryPostProcessor，该处理器将在刷新此应用程序上下文时应用于其内部 bean 工厂，在评估任何 bean 定义之前执行。以便在上下文配置期间调用。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the context does not hold an internal bean factory (usually if refresh() hasn't been called yet or if close() has already been called)
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果上下文未持有内部 BeanFactory（通常是因为尚未调用refresh()，或者已经调用了close())

items.translation: `getEnvironment` 接口 `EnvironmentCapable` 中

items.source: BeansException - if the bean factory could not be initialized
items.translation: BeansException - 如果无法初始化 Bean 工厂

items.source: applicationStartup - the new context event factory
items.translation: applicationStartup - 新的上下文事件工厂

items.source: postProcessor - the factory processor to register
items.translation: postProcessor - 要注册的工厂处理器

items.translation: listener - 要注册的 ApplicationListener

items.source: listener - the ApplicationListener to deregister

items.source: whether the context is still active
items.translation: 上下文是否仍然处于活动状态

items.source: the underlying bean factory
items.translation: 底层 BeanFactory

items.source: The name of the bootstrap executor bean in the context: "bootstrapExecutor".
items.translation: 上下文中的 bootstrap executor bean 名称为："bootstrapExecutor"。

items.source: Name of the ConversionService bean in the factory: "conversionService".
items.translation: 工厂中ConversionService 豆的名称："conversionService"。

items.source: Name of the LoadTimeWeaver bean in the factory: "loadTimeWeaver".
items.translation: 工厂中LoadTimeWeaverbean的名称："loadTimeWeaver"。

items.source:
Add a new ApplicationListener that will be notified on context events
such as context refresh and context shutdown.
items.translation: 添加一个新的 ApplicationListener，以便在上下文事件（如上下文刷新和上下文关闭）发生时收到通知。

items.source:
Add a new BeanFactoryPostProcessor that will get applied to the internal
bean factory of this application context on refresh, before any of the
bean definitions get evaluated.
items.translation: 添加一个新的 BeanFactoryPostProcessor，该处理器将在刷新此应用程序上下文时应用于其内部 bean 工厂，在评估任何 bean 定义之前执行。

items.source:
Register the given protocol resolver with this application context,
allowing for additional resource protocols to be handled.
items.translation: 将此协议解析器注册到此应用程序上下文中，以允许处理额外的资源协议。

items.source:
Close this application context, releasing all resources and locks that the
implementation might hold.
items.translation: 关闭此应用程序上下文，释放实现可能持有的所有资源和锁。

items.source: Return the internal bean factory of this application context.
items.translation: 返回此应用上下文的内部 BeanFactory。

items.source:
Load or refresh the persistent representation of the configuration, which
might be from Java-based configuration, an XML file, a properties file, a
relational database schema, or some other format.
items.translation: 加载或刷新配置的持久化表示，该配置可能来自基于 Java 的配置、XML 文件、属性文件、关系数据库模式或其他格式。

items.source:
Register a shutdown hook with the JVM runtime, closing this context
on JVM shutdown unless it has already been closed at that time.
items.translation: 在 JVM 运行时注册一个关闭钩子，除非此时该上下文已经被关闭，否则在 JVM 关闭时关闭此上下文。

items.source: Specify the ClassLoader to load class path resources and bean classes with.
items.translation: 指定用于加载类路径资源和 Bean 类的 ClassLoader。

items.source: Set the parent of this application context.
items.translation: 设置此应用程序上下文的父级。
